entities.name: Invasion of Argoth
entities.description: Event in 57 AR in which Harbin and Mishra brought armies to Argoth, starting a six-year battleground.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Island whose resources were stripped and which became a battleground.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Brought the Combined Kingdoms to Argoth.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brought the Fallaji Empire to Argoth.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Whose schemes led Mishra to the island.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Ruler of Argoth's defenders at the Court of Titania in Citanul.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Later arrival carrying the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Gwenna
entities.description: Carried off the island with Hajar.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Sent Harbin to oppose Gwenna and Hajar.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact Ashnod carried; it required magic to use.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Faction that demanded Ashnod give them the Sylex.

entities.name: Combined Kingdoms
entities.description: Nations brought by Harbin to Argoth.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Empire brought by Mishra to Argoth.

entities.name: Citanul
entities.description: Location of the Court of Titania.

entities.name: Battle at Argoth
entities.description: The last battle at which the invasion culminated.

events.summary: Harbin brings the Combined Kingdoms to Argoth and starts stripping its resources; Mishra brings the Fallaji Empire; defenders retaliate.
events.quote: The island's defenders retaliated, starting a six-year-long battleground.

events.summary: Harbin is summoned to the Court of Titania, asks for aid against Mishra, is refused, and leaves on foot.
events.quote: he had to return on foot

events.summary: Ashnod arrives with the Golgothian Sylex; Mishra is unimpressed; she gives the Brotherhood of Gix a counterfeit.
events.quote: Ashnod then gave them a counterfeit sylex to trick them

events.summary: Ashnod arranges a ship carrying Gwenna and Hajar off the island to raid Urza's shipyards; Harbin is sent by Tawnos to oppose them.
events.quote: Harbin was sent by Tawnos to oppose them.

events.summary: The invasion culminates with the last Battle at Argoth.
events.quote: The invasion culminated with the last Battle at Argoth .

relations.quote: Harbin tried to persuade Titania to side with the Combined Kingdoms to defeat Mishra
Harbin was sent by Tawnos to oppose them.
